Creating route-1 or route-2 fixtures, implementing the workspace or application, selecting concrete dependencies, configuring infrastructure, or deploying to abris.653915.com.
Changing product requirements, scope, UX behavior, acceptance criteria, PROD-DEC-005 through PROD-DEC-010, or the owner-approved fixture-rights boundary.

expected_outputs: return-manifest.json conforming to the registered return schema with result_type REQUIREMENTS_REVIEW and decision NO_DECISION.

outputs/task-thinslice-001-design-revision-confirmation.md containing exact reviewed-source identity, revision disposition, R/N finding crosswalk, TD-GATE-001 through TD-GATE-004 status, AU-AGENT-003 independence/status review, blocking and non-blocking findings, remaining evidence gates, limitations, and the exact next engineering step.
acceptance_criteria: The response reviews every checksum-registered required input and identifies exact source commit 395c5d62975ba0f52e0da69af256ef870bf02770 and the full revision range.
The response explicitly checks R-1 through R-8 and N-1 through N-7/N-9 against the revised canonical artifacts and does not infer closure from status records alone.

The response independently checks the AU-AGENT-003 report, its exact review and reverification sources, allowed Engineering Verification Status, finding severities, preserved history, and independence boundary.
The response distinguishes design-level closure from missing fixture, implementation, runtime, performance, deployment, release, and product-acceptance evidence.
Any required rework identifies the affected source, severity, violated requirement or invariant, owner, and closure evidence.
The response states whether TD-GATE-004 is closed and whether route-1 fixture production and later workspace scaffolding may proceed under the remaining gates.
The response preserves product meaning, technical ownership, and documentation ownership and assigns no project VERIFIED status.
The return uses COMPLETED, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED with decision NO_DECISION; the revision disposition is recorded inside the report.
